svg.title: I Ching: hexagram 63, After Completion, in gold
Tarot: two cards fanned, the front one a star
Astrology: the zodiac wheel, the Sun at its heart, a chart's aspects
Solitaire: three cards fanned on green felt, the Ace of Spades in front
Minesweeper: a mine on a grid of tiles, a red flag and two numbers beside it

Pinball: a table from above, three pop bumpers under the arch (one struck, sparking), a portal, a bank of drop targets, a spinner, slingshots, two flippers, the plunger lane lit, and a silver ball in flight
Go: black and white stones on a wooden board, black's last stone marked
Checkers: black and white pieces on a brown and cream board, one black king with a crown
Mahjong: three tiles fanned on green felt, the red dragon, five dots and six bamboo
